requires: authorized two-client runtime for visual steps

scenarios.title: Master A-Life order authority, separate legacy arbiter flag OFF
steps: Start disposable pinned server with EVEJS_COOP_ALIFE=1, all unrelated behavior flags OFF
Use a verified named native pilot and activate optional personal goals while legacy arbiter flag stays OFF
Observe original native world tick and effective order lease
expected: Shared native order bridge used when an opted-in director issues a command
No automatic raids, markets, cargo or rewards from the master flag

scenarios.title: Two native directors compete for the same NPC
steps: Create an eligible native pirate and trigger a RAID order
Within the same tick request a conflicting CIVILIAN or PATROL order
Request emergency TACTICS response
expected: Lower-priority order cannot replace the active RAID lease
Approved survival TACTICS preempts only through existing authoritative arbiter

scenarios.title: NPC ammunition shortage and native retreat/rearm
steps: Equip native NPC with finite authoritative ammo and verified module
Consume last charge in actual native combat and sample ammo shortage
Observe retreat, station approach, earned-ISK purchase and fitted charge
expected: Only physically bought and fitted charge counts as RESUPPLY outcome

scenarios.title: Native trade is not A-Life intent completion
steps: Trigger A-Life BUY_SUPPLIES for a real trader
Disable native market RPC, then re-enable and execute one actual order
Run scripts/alife-audit.cjs --reconcile against append-only event file
expected: Blocked or missing RPC never appears as a settled trade
Proof is counted only with exact matching real NPC, station, cargo and buy receipt
requiredEvidence: native TRADE_SETTLED receipt and full cargo provenance

scenarios.title: One native market receipt replayed after server restart
steps: Make one legitimate native buy with a persistent cargo receipt
Restart disposable server retaining saved world and log
Replay duplicated log lines and run read-only reconciliation
expected: Same cargo and market order receipt cannot match two A-Life intents
No extra native wallet or cargo credit

scenarios.title: Haul, refine and manufacture remain unverified until authoritative settling
steps: Mine ore into actual NPC hull and transfer to native hauler
Reach physically verified station and settle source cargo to warehouse/refinery
Only then create actual native industry job and sell output via native market
expected: No observer plan is counted as real delivery/job/sale
Every stage has original cargoID, settlement and job/order receipts
requiredEvidence: mining controller target and cargo growth

scenarios.title: Native raid/escort events visible to two real connected clients
steps: Connect two authorized co-op clients to the same real system
Observe independent NPC pirate and convoy action accepted by native engine
Read /events or Local signal and voluntarily join a fleet
expected: Both clients see the same physical NPC and event without extra NPC spawns
Alerts are grounded in native accepted orders, not fabricated kill claims
requiredEvidence: server scene identity and native orders

scenarios.title: Crash during uncertain native trade or combat
steps: Trigger native market RPC or NPC ammo debit with controlled fault in disposable world
Restart with all journal and SQLite state preserved
Attempt same NPC activity and inspect repair status
expected: Ambiguous outcome never retries a wallet/cargo debit automatically
No missing journal is treated as permission to mint or refire
